items.q: How do I choose the right glove size?
items.a: Measure the circumference of your dominant hand just below the knuckles in centimetres. That number, rounded to the nearest size in our size guide, is your glove size. Between sizes: go up for a roll-finger glove and down for a negative cut.

items.q: How do I make my gloves last longer?
items.a: Rinse them in cool water after each session, never wring or tumble-dry, and let them air-dry flat away from direct heat. Our Grip Restore kit refreshes the latex between matches.

items.q: What file should I upload for my club crest?
items.a: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image under 300 KB works best. A transparent PNG at least 512 px wide gives the sharpest print. Vector artwork can be emailed to our design team after you order.
